collocatus in Coelo, eique insidens similis aspectu lapidi Jaspidi &
Sardio, circa thronum iris, & throni viginti quatuor, iisque insiden-
tes totidem Seniores, albis vestibus induti, & capita coronas au-
reas redimiti, ex throno vibrata fulgura, tonitrua, voces &c. taceo

cti nimirum, venerandi thronis, aetate, sanctitate, & coronis aureis,

XIX.28. 1.Cor.VI.2. utpote qui & in terris adhuc versantes justis-

page.notes: The left margin note is the running title printed beside the text, transcribed as a note.
